page_P1.mp3: Welcome to your Part 1 workspace — the risk register for the Midtown medical office building.
Here is how this page works.
You'll build five rows, one risk in each: first classify it, then write it as cause, event, and consequence, and give it an owner and a trigger.
Notice that every row has its own voice guide — the small play button beside the risk number — so tap it any time to hear exactly what to do for that risk.
When all five rows are filled in, press Run analysis at the bottom; it checks your work and flags anything that looks off-scene or missing.
You don't have to agree with every flag — fix what you want to, then press Finish.
The moment you submit, a backup file downloads to your computer automatically, and your work is recorded for grading.
After that you can simply close the window — or, once Module 3 opens, move on to Part 2.
That's the whole page — press play on any row's guide, and let's get started.
